comments.cms_write_mutex(): Acquire the installation CMS transaction lock before statement row locks.
comments.content_fields: Stable field identities owned by one content type; no executable schema or values.
comments.content_types: Stable Registry type identities only; semantic schemas and commands are not implemented.
comments.permission_operations: Registered Go operations; migration seeds the exact closed operation set.
comments.role_grants: Explicit installation grants only; content and delegation authority shapes are deferred.
comments.role_grants.can_delegate: Allows delegation only within the actor's authorized delegation envelope.
comments.roles: Installation-local role identities; role names never authorize an operation.
comments.roles.state: Only active roles grant permissions; restore returns disabled.
comments.sessions: Opaque session digests; never exposed through public views.
comments.sessions.csrf_digest: SHA-256 digest of a separate CSRF token; never a plaintext bearer.
comments.sessions.kind: Only restricted preauth storage exists; full and enrollment sessions are not implemented.
comments.user_roles: Explicit account-role memberships; inactive accounts and roles retain memberships.
comments.users: Dormant CMS account identities; no active accounts before MFA enrollment is implemented.
comments.users.credential_version: Positive credential generation reserved for future session revocation checks.
comments.users.login_key: Unique canonical login identifier; normalization belongs to the future enrollment service.
comments.users.state: Only pending and disabled accounts exist in this foundation; neither authenticates.

functions.keep_route_reservation:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.keep_route_reservation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'резервирования публичных адресов постоянны' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$function$
functions.lock_languages:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lock_languages(codes text[])
 RETURNS SETOF public.languages
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT l.* FROM public.languages AS l WHERE l.code = ANY(codes)
 ORDER BY l.code COLLATE "C" FOR SHARE OF l;
$function$
functions.ui_placeholders:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ui_placeholders(value text)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT m[1] ORDER BY m[1]),'{}'::text[])
 FROM regexp_matches(value,'\{([a-z][a-z0-9_]*)\}','g') AS m
$function$

views.public_article_routes:
SELECT r.language_code,
    r.slug,
    r.article_id,
    t.slug AS current_slug,
    t.revision_id
   FROM (public.public_routes r
     JOIN public.public_article_translations t ON (((r.article_id = t.article_id) AND (r.language_code = t.language_code))));
views.public_article_translations:
SELECT t.article_id,
    t.revision_id,
    t.language_code,
    t.title,
    t.slug,
    t.body_markdown,
    r.created_at AS published_at
   FROM (((public.article_revision_translations t
     JOIN public.articles a ON (((t.article_id = a.id) AND (t.revision_id = a.published_revision_id))))
     JOIN public.article_revisions r ON (((t.revision_id = r.id) AND (t.article_id = r.article_id))))
     JOIN public.languages l ON (((t.language_code = l.code) AND l.is_enabled)));
views.public_languages:
SELECT code,
    name,
    native_name,
    direction
   FROM public.languages
  WHERE is_enabled;
views.public_site:
SELECT r.id,
    r.title,
    r.description,
    r.default_language,
    r.fallback_language,
    r.tagline,
    r.notice,
    r.accent
   FROM (((public.site_state s
     JOIN public.site_revisions r ON (((s.published_id = r.id) AND r.sealed)))
     JOIN public.languages d ON (((r.default_language = d.code) AND d.is_enabled)))
     JOIN public.languages f ON (((r.fallback_language = f.code) AND f.is_enabled)));
views.public_ui_languages:
SELECT c.revision_id,
    c.language_code,
    c.name,
    c.native_name,
    c.direction
   FROM ((public.site_revision_languages c
     JOIN public.public_site s ON ((c.revision_id = s.id)))
     JOIN public.languages l ON (((c.language_code = l.code) AND l.is_enabled)));
views.public_ui_messages:
SELECT m.revision_id,
    m.language_code,
    m.message_key,
    m.message_value
   FROM (public.site_revision_messages m
     JOIN public.public_ui_languages c ON (((m.revision_id = c.revision_id) AND (m.language_code = c.language_code))));
